Package controller

Class InvoiceController

java.lang.Object
controller.InvoiceController
public class InvoiceController extends Object
This class manages invoice-related operations such as generating, updating, and retrieving invoices for orders.

    • generateInvoice

      public void generateInvoice(Client loggedInClient, Order order, DBManager dbManager, MainController mainController)
      Generates an invoice for a given order and stores it in the database.
      Parameters:
      loggedInClient - The client associated with the invoice.
      order - The order for which the invoice is generated.
      dbManager - The database manager.
      mainController - The main controller for accessing cart information.

    • updateInvoice

      public void updateInvoice(Client loggedInClient, Order order, Cart cart)
      Updates an existing invoice with new order and cart details.
      Parameters:
      loggedInClient - The client associated with the invoice.
      order - The order whose invoice is updated.
      cart - The updated cart information.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If no existing invoice is available to update.
